item.title: Why It Takes 15 Years To Train A Subspecialist Doctor — Physician
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Malaysia can take 13-15 years to train a subspecialist doctor, largely due to waiting periods, service requirements, and administrative hurdles rather than extra training. Streamlining the pathway and investing more in training could help produce specialists faster. The post Why It Takes 15 Years To Train A Subspecialist Doctor — Physician appeared first on CodeBlue .
